outlook.synopsis: El Niño is strengthening, with a greater than 90% chance of a very strong event during the Northern Hemisphere fall and winter 2026-27.

stations.name: Merced R at Happy Isles Bridge, Yosemite
stations.note: Yosemite's high country before it reaches the Valley. No dams above.

stations.name: Merced R at Pohono Bridge, Yosemite
stations.note: The bottom of Yosemite Valley. Unregulated; the classic Yosemite flood gage.

stations.name: Tuolumne R, Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne above Hetch Hetchy
stations.note: The wild Tuolumne just above Hetch Hetchy Reservoir. No dams above.

stations.name: Tuolumne R near Hetch Hetchy
stations.note: Below O'Shaughnessy Dam: what San Francisco's reservoir lets go.

stations.name: Big Creek above Whites Gulch, near Groveland
stations.note: A 16-square-mile foothill creek near Groveland. Rain-fed, no dams; often dry by fall.

stations.name: Tuolumne R below La Grange Dam
stations.note: Below Don Pedro and La Grange dams: what enters the valley.

stations.name: Tuolumne R at Modesto
stations.note: The Tuolumne on the valley floor, near its mouth on the San Joaquin.

stations.name: Stanislaus R at Ripon
stations.note: Below New Melones Reservoir, near the confluence with the San Joaquin.
